**Observation Log:**

- [FACT] The North American Telugu Society (NATS) is a non-profit organization formed in 2009 by 200 volunteers.
- [FACT] NATS aims to serve Telugu communities across North America through cultural, spiritual, social, and educational activities.
- [FACT] NATS has a 24x7 helpline (1-888-483-5848) to provide immediate assistance to anyone in need.
- [EVENT] NATS holds a bi-annual 3-day convention attended by approximately 8000 people to celebrate Telugu culture.
- [EVENT] Sambaralu is a cultural event held as part of NATS' bi-annual convention.
- [EVENT] NATS organizes a Million Can Drive every year across the US to collect food items for local food banks and shelters.
- [EVENT] NATS conducts various cultural programs, including classical dance and music programs, folk arts, and theater performances.
- [EVENT] NATS conducts educational programs such as seminars, workshops, and training programs on various topics.
- [EVENT] NATS is involved in community service activities, including volunteering at local shelters, food banks, and schools.
- [EVENT] NATS organizes sports events such as cricket tournaments and outdoor activities.
